Text.Text: That deserves an ovation. The stolen routine is stopped, and your own act has earned its place. You've finished my Perfect Flurry trials. I have no further work for you here.
Admission to these trials requires rank 50 in Throwing. Reach it and come back. A good act starts with practiced hands.

A Qion test crew has turned my throwing routine into a reckless weapons trial. Recover their log so I can see how they've changed it. Defeat six Perfect Flurry Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. I'll give you the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Perfect Flurry.

Here's the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key. Use 'Qion Test Site' in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Perfect Flurry Adepts, then return with the Perfect Flurry Qion Test Log.

Every blade in the air before the first one lands. That's the whole act and the whole discipline. The crowd always thought it was speed. It isn't - it's sequencing. Throw one, throw two, throw three, and your hand is already home for four while one is still climbing. I closed three seasons on the exhibition circuit with it, and nobody ever saw my hand stop. Nobody ever will.

A test crew squatting in the Qion site. They got hold of a recording of my final season and decided the flurry was a firing solution - grind out the art, keep the arithmetic. Their adepts rehearse my sequences in the cold until the beauty is dead and only the killing is left. I'd sue, but the venue is a frozen weapons range. So I'm sending you instead.

The Qion Test Log is their scorebook - every rehearsal of my routine, timed and graded like ordnance. In my show, the log was the wager board. The house posted my count and the crowd bet against it; the crowd always lost. I want to read what my act is worth in their numbers. Know your critics, darling. Then close their show.
Defeat six Perfect Flurry Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon.
You've defeated six Perfect Flurry Adepts. Let me see the Perfect Flurry Qion Test Log.
The book is back in honest hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using a regulator to drive the trials harder. Take it out of their hands. Defeat five Perfect Flurry Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat five Perfect Flurry Specialists to secure the Perfect Flurry Cryo-Range Regulator, then return to me.

My ice-stage finale - 'The Frozen Rain,' the bill called it. The regulator held the stage at the exact chill where a blade rings like a chime on release. The crowd heard music. The Qion crew heard tolerances. Bring it back. That sound belongs in a show, not a trial.

The count. One-two-three isn't three throws - it's one phrase, a sentence your hand speaks without breathing. Their specialists count with a chronometer. You'll count with your pulse. And when you hear your own rhythm stutter, stop throwing. The flurry punishes a broken phrase worse than a dropped blade.

The adepts memorized my act. The specialists rebuilt it - release timing, arc spacing, recovery steps, all of it stripped to numbers and drilled in lethal cold. A copy of a copy, but a fast one. Five of them working one lane is nearly a flurry in itself. Nearly. The difference is the pause before their fourth throw. Use it.
Defeat five Perfect Flurry Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon.
You've defeated five Perfect Flurry Specialists. Let me see the Perfect Flurry Cryo-Range Regulator.
One less rigged test to worry about. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden controls the site's next test. Beat him and recover the test crest. Defeat the Perfect Flurry Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Qion Test Site, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Perfect Flurry Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Perfect Flurry Frostburned Test Crest.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Perfect Flurry Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Every trial the site ever passed was stamped under that crest, back when the range tested honest hardware. The frost burned it black the year the site froze over, and now the crew wears it like a stolen headliner's star. I toured under a star like it once. It goes to whoever owns the stage - and the stage is about to change hands.

Their choreographer. He drills my sequences into the specialists and grades the adepts on how faithfully they butcher them. And he's good - I'll say it plainly, vanity intact - good enough to add a fourth-throw variation I never staged. That's the part that should worry you. Watch his off hand. Everyone watches the throwing hand. The act is always in the other one.

Defeat the Perfect Flurry Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Perfect Flurry Warden. Let me see the Perfect Flurry Frostburned Test Crest.
The warden's protection is broken. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior operators are still signing off on the routine. Bring me their override chip. Defeat four members of the Perfect Flurry Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat four members of the Perfect Flurry Inner Circle to secure the Perfect Flurry Site Chief's Override Chip, then return to me.

Everything with a lock or a fuse. Gate seals, lane heaters, trial authorizations - the site chief carried it when the range ran honest tests, and whoever holds it now can green-light any rehearsal they like. In their pocket it's a licence to keep butchering my act. In mine, it's the deed to the theater.

The four who found that recording of my final season and decided it was ordnance. Two handled the money, two ran the drills - and all four throw. Don't let the word 'producer' fool you; on that circuit even the bookkeepers came up through the act. Together they'll try to stage a flurry around you. Answer with your own. Three voices, one phrase.

Sharp of you to ask. Its twin ran my old venue - house lights, stage locks, the ice under 'The Frozen Rain.' Whoever held the chip held the show, so I held it myself, every night, right here against the wrist. A performer who doesn't own her stage is a prop. Bring me theirs, and I'll finally own two.

Defeat four members of the Perfect Flurry Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Perfect Flurry Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon.
You've defeated four members of the Perfect Flurry Inner Circle. Let me see the Perfect Flurry Site Chief's Override Chip.
That closes the crew's account. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the final act. Defeat him in the Overload Chamber to complete the throwing trials. Defeat the Perfect Flurry Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Overload Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Perfect Flurry Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Twelve seasons, half of them opposite him on the same bill. I sold spectacle; he sold silence - a flurry so clean the crowd forgot to cheer. When the circuit folded he walked off without a word, and the next I heard, the Qion crew had a master. I used to wonder why he never bowed. Now I know. He was never performing for the house. He was rehearsing for something. You, maybe.

Then it's yours - the whole act, the real one. Every blade in the air before the first one lands, and your hand already home. What he carries, you'll carry off his stage. That's how it has always passed: hand to hand, never written down. And I'll say the vain part plainly - beat him, and I finally get to watch the perfect flurry from a seat. I've never once seen it from the house.

Bring companions and make him divide his attention. If he controls the whole fight's pace, you spend it reacting. Prepare your own timing and help whoever gets pressured. If he bows when it's done, tell me; I still have a private wager on that.

Defeat the Perfect Flurry Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Perfect Flurry Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
That deserves an ovation. The stolen routine is stopped, and your own act has earned its place. You've earned the right to train Perfect Flurry. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the wager.
I'll defeat six Perfect Flurry Adepts.
What exactly is the perfect flurry?
Who turned your routine into a weapons trial?
Why do you want their test log?
I don't take that bet yet.
Here's the Perfect Flurry Qion Test Log.
About the second act.
I'll defeat five Perfect Flurry Specialists.
The regulator was part of your show?
Teach me something before I go. What am I listening for?
What makes their specialists dangerous?
I'll sit this hand out for now.
Here's the Perfect Flurry Cryo-Range Regulator.
Back to the warden's bill.
I'll defeat the Perfect Flurry Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What's the story on the crest?
Who's the warden?
Let me book my two first.
Here's the Perfect Flurry Frostburned Test Crest.
About the producers.
I'll defeat four members of the Perfect Flurry Inner Circle.
What does the override chip control?
Who are the producers?
Did the chip have a place in your show too?
The producers keep their box seats a little longer.
Here's the Perfect Flurry Site Chief's Override Chip.
Back to the final act.
I'll face the Perfect Flurry Master and report back.
You shared a circuit with him?
And if I close his show?
How do I beat a hand that never drops?
Not yet. I want more rehearsal first.
The Perfect Flurry Master is defeated. Here's my report.
